meta.name: vercel-composition-patterns
meta.description: React composition patterns that scale. Use when refactoring components with boolean prop proliferation, building flexible component libraries, or designing reusable APIs. Triggers on tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture. Includes React 19 API changes.

copy.tagline: 用组合模式重构组件，消除布尔属性泛滥

copy.tagline_en: Refactor components with composition patterns to eliminate boolean prop proliferation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring components or designing reusable component libraries

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 写 React 组件时会按这套模式：能组合就不加布尔开关，状态放进 Provider，示例给错误和正确写法；React 19 项目里不再推荐 forwardRef。
howto.when: 当你要求重构带很多布尔开关的组件、搭建组件库，或任务涉及 compound components、render props、context providers 等架构话题时触发。

say.text: 我把一个组件加了五个布尔开关，帮我改成组合写法。
say.note: 会触发避免布尔开关的规则，给出前后对比。

say.text: 项目是 React 19，这些组件还在用 forwardRef，要怎么改？
say.note: 会调用 React 19 规则，建议改用 use()。

howto.what_en: Claude applies these React composition rules when coding: composition over boolean props, state in providers, examples include wrong/correct code; for React 19 it avoids forwardRef.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor components with many boolean props, build a component library, or work on tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture.

say_en.text: My component has five boolean props; can you refactor it with composition?
say_en.note: Applies the avoid-boolean-props rule with before/after examples.

say_en.text: Turn this list into compound components and put the state in context.
say_en.note: Uses architecture and state rules to show reusable code.

say_en.text: We use React 19; these components still use forwardRef. How should we change them?
say_en.note: Applies the React 19 rule; recommends use() instead.
